title: Delfos - Ruins Structure ✅
description: Delfos is an ancient monument in a Minecraft vanilla-friendly style, inspired by the Oracle of Apollo, featuring massive ruins and mystical columns.
body:
![Delfos front](https://i.imgur.com/il0ZhFG.png)

Step into antiquity and discover the sacred sanctuary of Delfos with the **Delfos Mod**! This vanilla-friendly mod brings **grand, classical Greek ruins inspired by the Oracle of Apollo** into Minecraft, spawning on terraced mountainsides and rocky hills in mountain and forest biomes. Each site recreates the awe of the original sanctuary—crumbling colonnades, a luminous inner chamber, and vaults—filling your world with **lore, exploration, puzzles, and secret treasures**.

![Delfos aerial](https://i.imgur.com/RUql2sB.png)

Perfect for players who enjoy **exploration, world-building, and discovering landmarks with cultural and historical inspiration**, the Delfos ruins serve as unique points of interest to enrich your Minecraft adventures. Wander through crumbling colonnades, admire terraced sanctuaries and weathered mosaic floors, and let your imagination journey into the mysteries of an ancient Greek oracle carved into the mountainside.

![Delfos site](https://i.imgur.com/gHJo4BL.png)

Whether you're a **solo explorer or playing on a multiplayer server**, these ruins add **atmospheric depth, realism, and storytelling** potential to your world. Delfos is more than a monument—it's an invitation to uncover the mysteries of ancient Greece and the Oracle of Apollo, while enhancing the rugged, terraced beauty of mountainsides and forests in your Minecraft landscapes.
